verdict.rationale: Bruno's CLI (bru) lets you run collections, generate reports, and integrate with CI/CD, and its plain-text .bru file format means collections can be edited/scripted outside the UI, but there is no formal REST/HTTP API for the app itself (the docs probe found no OpenAPI/swagger endpoints) and the CLI is scoped to running/testing collections rather than full parity with all UI functions (e.g., AI script generation, doc editing, OAuth setup wizards, drag-and-drop management) which remain UI-only per the docs. missing for 10: a documented public API/CLI surface covering every UI capability (AI features, auth setup, doc editing, environment management) and independent confirmation that CLI/API usage matches UI parity.
